name: @acyclic-labs/sdk-workspace

scripts.check:types: tsc -p typescript/packages/filesystem/tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false && tsc -p typescript/packages/harness/tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false && tsc -p typescript/packages/inference/tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false && tsc -p typescript/packages/pi/tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false
scripts.test:contracts: tsc -b typescript/packages/actors typescript/packages/workers typescript/packages/objects typescript/packages/stream && node scripts/generate-public-rpc-matrix.mjs complete && node --test scripts/public-rpc-source.test.mjs && node typescript/packages/actors/test/grpc-conformance.mjs && node typescript/packages/stream/test/grpc-provider-conformance.mjs && node typescript/packages/stream/test/http-provider-conformance.mjs && node --test typescript/packages/objects/test/v2-conformance.mjs && bun test ./typescript/packages/objects/test/v2-conformance.mjs && node typescript/packages/objects/test/v2-grpc-conformance.mjs
scripts.check:native-adapter: bun run check && cargo build -p acyclic-fs-napi --locked && bun scripts/check-filesystem-napi.mjs --adapter
scripts.test: bun run check && bun run check:types && bun test --parallel=4 typescript/packages && bun run --filter '@acyclic-labs/fs' test && bun run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts:browser: bun run --filter '@acyclic-labs/objects' build:wasm && bun run --filter '@acyclic-labs/stream' build:wasm && tsc -b typescript/packages/actors typescript/packages/workers typescript/packages/objects typescript/packages/stream && node typescript/packages/actors/test/browser-http-conformance.mjs

description: The Acyclic SDK is the open contract and composition layer for building recursive, fork-join agent systems. It contains the Rust harness, public service interfaces, customer-machine implementations, conformance suites, and language bindings.
